title: How to Make a $1500 Sandwich in Only 6 Months
summary: A man spends six months and $1500 making a chicken sandwich entirely from scratch: growing vegetables, making salt from seawater, milking a cow for cheese, grinding wheat, collecting honey and killing a chicken.
why: Used as a go-to example of how much hidden effort and infrastructure lies behind simple everyday things.

quote.text: it takes them ~$1500 and 6 months to make a chicken sandwich and they still used a lot of equipment that they didn't make themselves.
